description: This file defines the Popup class for the Leaflet mapping library, including its options, lifecycle methods, event handling, layout, and integration with map layers. It also extends Map and Layer prototypes to support popup management.

classes.name: Popup
classes.description: A class extending DivOverlay used to create and manage popups on the map, with options for size, auto-pan, close button, and event handling.

methods.name: openOn
methods.description: Adds the popup to the map and makes it the active popup.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles the addition of the popup to the map, firing events and setting up event propagation.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Handles the removal of the popup from the map, firing events and cleaning up event listeners.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns the event handlers for the popup, including auto-pan and click-to-close.

methods.name: _initLayout
methods.description: Initializes the DOM layout for the popup, including content container, tip, and close button.

methods.name: _updateLayout
methods.description: Adjusts the size of the popup based on content and options.

methods.name: _animateZoom
methods.description: Handles zoom animations for the popup.

methods.name: _adjustPan
methods.description: Automatically pans the map to keep the popup in view if autoPan is enabled.

methods.name: _onCloseButtonClick
methods.description: Handles the close button click event to close the popup.

methods.name: _getAnchor
methods.description: Calculates the anchor point for the popup based on its source layer.
